scope: Read-only CPU audit and existing saved evaluations; active training settings untouched

sampling.policy: equal train and new-validation token quotas across fixed-seed shuffled source shards; shuffled row groups and rows
sampling.split: fixed normalized-text SHA256 threshold independent of budgets; all pilot validation text hashes/URLs reserved first

training_shuffle: Independent sequential CPU-generator permutations per epoch, compact checksummed .npy; partial batches end at epoch boundaries
source_window_audit_limit: Source shard labels are coarse; this does not measure semantic or baseline-model difficulty shifts
supported: Global block shuffle and broad source proportions show no source-ordered later-domain switch
Fixed native probe sample bytes do not change, so its rebound is not a consequence of resampling evaluation batches
New and old peakLR runs share epoch0 order but have different loss minima; updates affect the trend
not_established: Strictly seen-sample deterioration in the new low-LR run
next_discriminating_check: Compare early and later saved new-run checkpoints on exactly fixed blocks all visited by the earlier checkpoint, plus blocks not visited by the later checkpoint. Do not change the active production run.
